description_expanded: Overview5.0(9 reviews)Gulf FrontGULF FRONT and Renovated -2 Bikes- Private Beach Access, FREE beach chairs- BMT 3AThe Space BMT 3A – Gulf-Front Luxury in Blue Mountain Beach! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Gulf-Front Condo – Stunning panoramic beach views from your private balcony Steps to the Sand – Walk straight to the sugar-white sands of 30A 3 Bedrooms / 3 Bathrooms – Spacious layout, perfect for families & groups King Master Suite – Wake up to ocean views, en-suite bath & balcony access Guest Suite with Queen Bed – Private retreat with a cozy, coastal feel Bunk Room – Great for kids or extra guests Open-Concept Living Area – Bright, airy, and perfect for relaxing after the beach Fully Equipped Kitchen – Stainless steel appliances & dining space for the whole crew Prime Location – Close to Seaside, Grayton Beach & 30A’s best dining & shopping FREE Set of Beach Chairs - Memorial Day to Labor Day, one set with two chairs and one umbrella Welcome to BMT 3ANestled directly on the Gulf, this luxurious Blue Mountain Beach condo is the ultimate 30A beachfront escape. With breathtaking views, an open and airy layout, and easy beach access, this is the perfect spot to relax and soak up the Emerald Coast’s beauty.Wake up to unobstructed Gulf views from the king master suite, sip your morning coffee on the private balcony, and spend your days toes in the sand just steps from your door. The resort-style pool and hot tub offer a refreshing retreat, while the open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area provides plenty of space to gather after a day in the sun.Whether you're biking to Seaside and Grayton Beach, enjoying fresh seafood at local hotspots, or simply unwinding on your private balcony with a sunset view, BMT 3A is your perfect home base for a dream 30A getaway.Multiple families or guests? SEE UNIT 3B located in the same complex in the unit below. It's a one-story, one-bedroom unit located just below this unit on the ground floor.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival*** NO CABLE. STREAMING ONLY**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (8):-Master Bedroom 2nd Floor: King Bed, Private Balcony, Private Bathroom-Guest Bedroom, 2nd Floor: 2 Queen Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Living Room, 1st Floor: Queen Sleeper SofaAREA ATTRACTIONS:Welcome to Blue Mountain Beach, a hidden gem along Florida’s scenic Highway 30A! Known for its breathtaking white sand beaches, vibrant turquoise waters, and relaxed coastal charm, this community is the perfect destination for those seeking great food, sweet treats, shopping, and outdoor adventures.Start your day with a delicious breakfast at Blue Mountain Bakery, then swing by For the Health of It for quick grocery essentials and organic treats. When it’s time for lunch or dinner, savor fresh seafood and coastal flavors at Red Fish Taco, Shunk Gulley, or Cowgirl Kitchen, all just a short bike ride away. Enjoy some shopping at The Stalls on 30A, where you’ll find unique local treasures and coastal-inspired finds. And when it’s time for something sweet, indulge in homemade ice cream from Blue Mountain Beach Creamery, just a quick stroll from your doorstep.Whether you’re here to unwind on the beach, explore the area, or simply soak in the laid-back 30A lifestyle, you’ve found the perfect place to stay!
